requirement.title: Session list table
requirement.description: Top zone of the dashboard displays a navigable table of all detected agent panes. Each row shows: tmux target (session:window.pane), status indicator, git branch, truncated cwd, and duration.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given 3 detected agent panes, when the dashboard renders, then 3 rows appear in the session table, each showing session target, status dot, branch name, shortened cwd (~/G/A style), and duration since Claude process started.
Given agent duration is measured from the Claude Code process start time, when process has been running 2h 15m, then duration column shows "2h 15m".
Given the user presses j/↓ or k/↑, when navigating the session list, then the selection indicator (▸) moves to the next/previous row.
Given status is "active", then the dot shows ●. Given status is "idle", then the dot shows ○. Given status is "needs_attention", then the dot shows ⚡. Given status is "unknown", then the dot shows ?.

requirement.title: Detail panel — compact view with JSONL conversation preview
requirement.description: Compact view (default) shows: metadata header line (target, version, model, context %), followed by a conversation flow preview sourced from the JSONL session file. The JSONL file is located by mapping the pane's CWD to a Claude project hash (~/.claude/projects/<hash>/*.jsonl). Shows last 2-3 user/assistant exchanges.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given session arcforge:1.1 is selected and running Claude 2.1.87 with Opus 4.6 at 27% context, when detail panel renders in compact mode, then it shows "arcforge:1.1 — Claude 2.1.87 · Opus 4.6 · 27% ctx" as the header.

Given the session's JSONL file contains recent user and assistant messages, when detail panel renders in compact mode, then it shows the last 2-3 exchanges as conversation flow (e.g., "You: fix the auth bug" / "AI: I'll update the middleware...").
Given no session is detected (empty list), when detail panel renders, then it shows "No agent sessions detected".
Given the JSONL file cannot be found or read, when detail panel renders in compact mode, then it shows the metadata header only, with "No conversation data" below.

requirement.title: Detail panel — expanded view with scrollback relay
requirement.description: Ctrl-E toggles the detail panel into an expanded view that relays the full tmux scrollback history via capture-pane -S - (captured on-demand, not during polling). The view is scrollable with j/k (1 line) and Ctrl-U/Ctrl-D (10 lines). Esc closes. When expanded, the session list is dimmed and the notification feed is hidden to maximize vertical space.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given a session is selected and user presses Ctrl-E, when the expanded view opens, then the full scrollback content is displayed (captured via tmux capture-pane -S -).
Given the expanded view is open, when user presses j/k or arrow keys, then the view scrolls by 1 line. Ctrl-U/Ctrl-D scrolls by 10 lines.
Given the expanded view is open, when user presses Esc, then the view closes and returns to normal mode with compact detail panel.
Given the expanded view is open, when the view renders, then the session list is dimmed and the notification feed is hidden.
Given the expanded scrollback capture fails (tmux error), when the expanded view tries to render, then it shows "Failed to capture scrollback" and does not crash.

requirement.title: Notification feed
requirement.description: Lower portion of middle zone shows recent notification events in reverse chronological order with timestamps.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given 3 notification events have occurred, when notification feed renders, then events appear newest-first, each with a relative timestamp (e.g., "2m ago").
Given a new notification arrives, when the feed updates, then the new event appears at the top.

requirement.title: Command input with send-keys
requirement.description: Bottom zone provides a text input. When the user types and presses Enter, the text is sent to the selected agent pane via tmux send-keys.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given session arcforge:1.1 is selected and user types "yes" and presses Enter, when Commander executes, then tmux send-keys -t arcforge:1.1 "yes" Enter is invoked.
Given send-keys succeeds, when the UI updates, then a brief "sent" indicator appears next to the input field.
Given no session is selected, when user presses Enter, then nothing is sent and the input is ignored.

requirement.title: Send interrupt to selected pane
requirement.description: Ctrl-C sends an interrupt signal to the selected agent pane, not to gmux itself.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given session arcforge:1.1 is selected and user presses Ctrl-C, when Commander executes, then tmux send-keys -t arcforge:1.1 C-c is invoked.
Given no session is selected, when user presses Ctrl-C, then nothing happens (gmux does not quit).

requirement.title: Key bindings
requirement.description: Dashboard keyboard navigation and action shortcuts.
requirement.trace: REQ-F002, REQ-F005, REQ-F006, REQ-F007, REQ-F008, REQ-F009, REQ-F018

acceptance_criteria.criterion: ↑/↓ or j/k navigates session list.
Enter sends typed text to selected session.
Ctrl-C sends interrupt to selected session.
Ctrl-K kills selected tmux session (with confirmation since it's destructive).
Ctrl-N enters session creation flow.
Ctrl-E toggles expanded detail view (full scrollback relay).
Ctrl-F switches the main monitor's tmux client to the selected session.
q or Ctrl-Q quits gmux immediately without confirmation.

requirement.title: Focus session on main monitor
requirement.description: Ctrl-F switches the main monitor's tmux client to view the selected session. When multiple tmux clients exist, show a client picker.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given one non-gmux tmux client exists, when user presses Ctrl-F, then tmux switch-client -t (selected session) is invoked on that client.
Given multiple non-gmux tmux clients exist, when user presses Ctrl-F, then a picker appears listing available clients. User selects one, then switch-client runs.
Given no non-gmux tmux clients exist, when user presses Ctrl-F, then a message "No tmux clients available" is shown briefly.
